mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it triggers a flight to quality and defensive sectors, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output decline directly reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 thousand persons indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS > 100,000 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals demand reallocation away from residential investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS > 350,000, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates dual supply-labor market shocks that reduce economic activity and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
